feed.title: Joshternet What's New

entry.title: Worth Wandering: Radio Aporee
entry.summary: A worldwide collection of field recordings that lets you explore the sounds of cities, forests, rivers, train stations and ordinary places, with experimental radio projects that turn listening into an entirely different way of experiencing the world.

entry.title: Enterprise sales teams, please, I beg you, stop
entry.summary: I asked for a price on a few extra seats of software we already pay for. Two days and a pile of irrelevant questions later, I got one.

entry.title: Learning a New Tech Stack with an LLM

I'm writing more emails, and engaging with human beings as much as I can, and that part's been great.
